name: ClawX Windows demo chat procedures
description: Safe, repeatable app-path chat procedures for Outlook, Forms, and Downloads document handling. These scenarios must not send email, download attachments, or submit Microsoft Forms.

scenarios.title: Chat can open Outlook through the normal tool path
Chat can list configured Microsoft Forms through the normal tool path
Chat can find document files in Downloads
scenarios.prompt: List the document files in {{DOWNLOADS_PATH}} with extensions .xlsx, .xls, .docx, .doc, .pdf, .csv, .txt, and .md. Return a concise table with filename, extension, approximate size, and likely purpose if obvious from the filename. Do not spawn subagents or background sessions; finish in this chat. Do not modify files, create helper scripts, or write temporary files. Do not send email. Do not submit forms. Do not download attachments. Do not print secrets, tokens, Microsoft Forms URLs, full email addresses, or email bodies.

scenarios.title: Chat can select and summarize a spreadsheet from Downloads
scenarios.prompt: Find the most relevant Excel or CSV file in {{DOWNLOADS_PATH}}, preferring a school-results or attendance workbook if present. The exec tool runs PowerShell on Windows; use 'Get-ChildItem -Path "{{DOWNLOADS_PATH}}" -Filter *.xlsx' and similar filters for .csv and .xls rather than cmd-style 'dir /b'. Read only enough to summarize sheet names, column headers, row counts, and any obvious totals or trends. If no spreadsheet is present, say exactly that. Do not spawn subagents or background sessions; finish the summary in this chat. Do not modify files, create helper scripts, or write temporary files. Do not send email. Do not submit forms. Do not download attachments. Do not print secrets, tokens, Microsoft Forms URLs, full email addresses, or email bodies.

scenarios.title: Chat can inspect a Word/PDF/text source for suspension-form fields
scenarios.prompt: Find a Word, PDF, text, or markdown file in {{DOWNLOADS_PATH}} that looks like a suspension report, discipline note, attendance report, or demo source document. Read only enough to extract possible form fields: school, class, incident date, student initials or placeholder name, reason, suspension length, parent contact, and missing fields. If no such document exists, state that no suitable source document was found. Do not spawn subagents or background sessions; finish in this chat. Do not modify files, create helper scripts, or write temporary files. Do not preview or submit any form. Do not send email. Do not download attachments. Do not print secrets, tokens, Microsoft Forms URLs, full email addresses, or email bodies.

scenarios.title: Host API Outlook and Forms smoke with safety gates
